moments.author: Sean Duffy
moments.quote: Planes are pushing back, taxiing, and taking off … it is safe to fly.
moments.why: Transportation Secretary reassuring travelers amid FAA nationwide ground‑stop chaos.

moments.author: Doug Robb (Hoobastank)
moments.quote: Performed “The Reason” crowd‑sing along in cabin midflight before ground stop.
moments.why: Iconic 2000s rock in impromptu mid‑air concert going viral amid flight shutdown.

moments.author: Simple Plan / The Used / Hoobastank
moments.quote: Bands turned Southwest flight into surprise concert singing hits like “Perfect,” “The Taste of Ink.”
moments.why: Collective mid‑air performance by nostalgic bands amid national ground stop is highly shareable.

moments.author: Jon Pardi
moments.quote: Peoria, we’re disappointed we won’t get to spend tonight with you … safety of our fans … is always the priority.
moments.why: Country star publicly cancels show amid credible bomb threat, resonating with concerned concertgoers.

moments.author: Peoria Mayor Rita Ali
moments.quote: Authorities identified a bomb … prompting a precautionary one‑mile evacuation.
moments.why: Credible bomb threat and evacuation in Peoria is dominating local discourse and shared widely.
